name: Chrysanthemum
description: Round flower burst whose stars carry long visible spark trails to the tips.

name: Horsetail
description: A directional break whose heavy tailed stars travel only a short distance then cascade downward.

name: Willow
description: Long-burning gold stars that droop and hang like weeping willow branches.

name: Whirl
description: A spinning corkscrew shower of sparks that rotates and ascends into a spiral column.

name: Comet
description: A single large bright tailed star launched skyward leaving a long thick spark trail.

name: Mine
description: A near-instantaneous upward blast of stars from ground level forming a wide cone plume.

name: Waterfall
description: Trailing stars that spread wide then cascade slowly downward like a shimmering gold curtain.

name: Pistil
description: A coloured outer burst around a contrasting glowing central core, two concentric colour layers.

name: Pearls
description: Large slow-burning stars arranged in a ring, each a glowing pearl.

name: Crackle
description: A dense cloud of small pellets that pop in rapid succession with sharp bright flashes.

name: Fountain
description: A sustained ground-origin column of glittering sparks rising in a narrow cone and cascading back.

name: Kamuro
description: Dense gold-to-silver brocade crown that cascades downward in a long glittering umbrella, very long hang.

name: Saturn
description: A central peony planet core framed by a separate equatorial ring of stars.

name: Bow Tie
description: Two opposed lobes fired in a flat plane, a cross or figure-eight shell.

name: Double Break
description: A shell that breaks, then breaks again into a second cloud of contrasting fragments.

name: Palm
description: A thick golden rising trunk then a sparse burst of large heavy arms that arc into fronds.

name: Crossette
description: Large comet stars that radiate outward then fracture mid-flight into crossing fragments.

name: Nishiki
description: A brocade-style trailing crown threaded with a contrasting coloured pistil core (diadem).

name: Brocade
description: White-gold crown with a hot lift streak, amber burst haze, and long falling brocade trails. The reference quality bar.

name: Outlined Star Shell
description: A sharp five-point outline with a smaller hot inner star and short, controlled streaks.

name: Ring
description: A perfectly symmetrical halo of stars expanding as a flat tilted circle.

name: Heart Shell
description: A crisp planar heart outline with a smaller warm inner heart and restrained trailing sparks.

name: Roman Candle
description: A ground tube that spits a cadenced sequence of glowing coloured stars that arc and flare.

name: Strobe
description: A spherical field of stars that oscillate between dark smoulder and sharp bright flashes.

name: Peony
description: Round radial burst of glowing stars without persistent trails.

name: Silver Fish
description: A swarm of self-propelled silver micro-stars that dart and swim through the sky like fish.
